title: poa uralensis
intro: Poa uralensis, commonly known as Korean bluegrass or mountain bluegrass, is a type of grass native to the mountainous regions of East Asia. It has been traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Poa uralensis include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve blood circulation, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Poa uralensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
